set.body: The first exact structural-capture optimization preserved all 48 historical transforms and reduced expanded-capture median by 55.9%, but fresh ordinary rigid and affine latency still missed the 1 s and 2 s median/p95 targets. Develop an independently checked reduction of the remaining left-channel FFT work, preferably real-pair forward/inverse packing or an equally exact computation change. Preserve the 125-rotation schedule, objectives, thresholds, candidate ordering, single-thread semantics, typed failures, and public API. Use development-only fixtures until the candidate is frozen, then generate and seal a new unopened accuracy and complete-cost court. Do not start C04 until GL passes.
set.title: FA-L32: Finish exact structural-capture latency reduction
